faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: Glenn discusses the Pro-Human Assembly, business success stories, and Macklemore's tour…
kurzfassung: Glenn analyzes the Pro-Human Assembly hosted by Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon in Washington regarding AI development and safeguards. He examines the viability of starting a new business in America through examples of multi-billion-dollar companies. Additionally, he covers the removal of rapper Macklemore from an Ed Sheeran tour following political statements on stage.
stichpunkte: Discussion of the Pro-Human Assembly in Washington hosted by Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon
Debate on balancing U.S. AI data center expansion against China with human-controlled safeguards
Examination of whether starting a business from the ground up remains obtainable in America
Success stories of businesses that started small and grew to be worth billions
Rapper Macklemore's removal as the opening act of the Ed Sheeran tour after statements about Palestine
beschreibung:
Glenn discusses the Pro-Human Assembly happening in Washington, hosted by Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, and argues that the U.S. must simultaneously build data centers to beat China in the AI race and demand human-controlled safeguards like off switches and independent inspectors. Is the American dream of starting a business still obtainable? Glenn shares success stories of multiple businesses that started from the ground up and are now worth billions. Rapper Macklemore has been removed as the opening act of the Ed Sheeran tour after using the stage to preach about Palestine, all because one father decided to take a stand against the indoctrination.
